lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: The high-luminance circular clusters are arranged in approximately 6 vertical columns posterior to the gill slits. A central triad of larger, high-intensity blobs forms an obtuse triangular pattern located midway between the dorsal carinae and the pectoral fin insertion.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are visible, intersecting with the larger circular blobs along the mid-lateral line to create a structured grid of high-luminance nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal ridge is visible across the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a distinct specular highlight on its superior edge and a dark shadow gradient on its inferior edge.

other_distinctive_markers: The visible pectoral fin exhibits a high-density population of micro-blobs, which are significantly smaller and more randomly distributed than the structured pattern found on the lateral flank.
